FILE docs/requirements.md
1: # Requirements
2: - R1. An order can be cancelled at any time before it ships.
3: - R2. Refunds are issued within 3 business days of cancellation.
4: - R3. Customers must receive an email for every status change.
5: - R4. Order history is kept for 7 years for audit.
FILE docs/design.md
1: # Design
2: - Cancellation is allowed only within 30 minutes of placing the order; after that the order is locked.
3: - Refunds are batched and run every Friday.
4: - Emails are sent only when the order ships or is delivered.
5: - Orders older than 2 years are deleted by a nightly job to save storage.
FILE docs/api.md
1: # API
2: - POST /orders/{id}/cancel ??returns 409 once the order has shipped; otherwise cancels it.
3: - GET /orders?since=... ??returns orders up to 7 years old.
4: - Webhook `order.status_changed` fires on every status change.
FILE src/orders.js
1: export function canCancel(order, now) {
2:   return now - order.placedAt < 30 * 60 * 1000;
3: }
